# t_funcs.exp_rise { #clerq.t_funcs.exp_rise }

```python
t_funcs.exp_rise(index)
```

Return a rising-exponential pulse time function.

``ampl * exp((t - off) / tau)`` up to ``off``, then zero: the time reverse
of :func:`exp_decay`, the envelope of a photon that a sink absorbs
perfectly.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                           |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``ampl_{index}``, ``off_{index}`` and |
|        | TFunc  | ``tau_{index}`` (the 1/e time of the amplitude) from args.            |
